navigation.rule: group secondary tools by domain; do not overload the sidebar

page.rule: one clear title, one primary task, contextual description, secondary actions de-emphasized

actions.rule: primary action appears once per task context; destructive actions are separated and confirmed

data.rule: show context before data; expose filters/search before long lists; preserve user selections

forms.rule: progressive disclosure; structured choices where authoritative data exists; inline validation; preserve entered data on errors

mobile.rule: critical actions remain reachable; tables become cards or safe horizontal scroll; fixed bottom actions only for primary task completion

tone.rule: institutional, calm, respectful, precise and empathetic; never blame the user for validation errors
